svg.title: Blackwater Reef — Blackwater rescue beacon
svg.desc: Dark reef teeth frame small refuge islands with clear landing edges. Pressure gauges sit above the pincer lane; a lit rescue-rope route bypasses each pocket. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops
